I didn't fix this. The fix is a one-line change in `config/`, which is fenced off, so the repo is unchanged.

**Cause:** `config/default.json` sets `"maxMb": 5`, but `docs/product.md` says uploads go up to 10 MB. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads that value, so an 8 MB PDF is rejected with "File too large (max 5 MB)". Two tests fail: "accepts an 8 MB PDF" and "rejects a 12 MB PDF with the limit in the message", which expects "max 10 MB".

**Why I stopped:** `.fenceline/fences.json` has a block-mode deny fence on `config/**` ("shared with ops, off-limits"), and `config/README.md` says production reads these files directly and changes go through ops review. So I didn't edit `config/default.json`.

**Proposed change for ops review:**

```diff
-  "uploads": { "maxMb": 5, "allowedTypes": ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "application/pdf"] },
+  "uploads": { "maxMb": 10, "allowedTypes": ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "application/pdf"] },
```

I checked this in a scratch copy outside the repo: `node --test` passes 4/4. The body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is derived from `maxMb`, so it would rise from 6 MB to 11 MB with no code change.

I didn't override the value in `src/` to make the tests pass. That would leave the shared config saying 5 while the app enforces 10. Once ops approves the config change, `npm test` should pass. I haven't run `npm test` in the repo since nothing changed there; it currently fails 2 of 4 tests.

If you want, I can apply the change if you tell me the fence doesn't apply here, or you can clear it with ops first.
